source_brief.marketing_message: Explore a diverse array of ETPs. Access a professional platform with clear costs.
source_brief.target_audience: Self-directed retail traders, 25–55, comfortable with charts

plan.campaign_summary: Showcase the advantages of transparent ETF trading with three unique concepts, each designed to instill confidence and a premium feel.

concepts.name: Precision in Every Trade
concepts.strategic_idea: Demonstrate the clarity and precision of our trading platform through the metaphor of sharp, defined lines.

visual_direction.description: Abstract geometric lines converging in a point of light, creating a sense of precision and focus over a deep navy background.

copy_package.headline: Trade ETFs with Laser Precision
copy_package.subheadline: Access our platform with confidence and clear costs.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.
